Overview

Corvallis is a city in OR with a population of 60,000. Home of Oregon State University with a strong engineering and agricultural research focus. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.6.
